source.symbol: l10n bump selected Gecko transforms and scalar worker policy
source.validation: Exact public Git source at the fixed comparison revision. Claims are static observations. No runtime, build, lint or live accessibility validation ran.

text:
loader: taskgraph.loader.transform:loader

transforms:
    - gecko_taskgraph.transforms.resolve_landoscript_keyed_by:transforms
    - gecko_taskgraph.transforms.task:transforms

task-defaults:
    run-on-repo-type: [hg]
    worker-type: lando
    worker:
        implementation: scriptworker-lando

        # Match Firefox behavior of only landing on beta when the tree is closed
        dontbuild: true
        ignore-closed-tree:
            by-project:
                comm-(central|beta|release|esr153): false
                default: true
